parameters.content:
Aadil HR Internship Hunter V7.1

Goal:
Maximize job-landing usefulness at the lowest practical cost.

V7 fixes prior critiques:
1. No floating live nodes
2. Explicit Apify, AI, Docs, and Sheets guards
3. Spreadsheet ID based persistence
4. Fixed sheet schemas inside apply_package
5. Human approval before Docs/PDF generation
6. Separate contact cap
7. CPT/visa risk blocker
8. Company-specific resume angle selector
9. Optional cover letter branch only for top jobs
10. Final output after apply package handling path
11. Reduced execution data retention

V7.1 patch:
- Adds real gated Gemini, OpenAI, and Perplexity HTTP booster branches.
- Default mode still costs $0.
- AI outputs are parsed safely and treated as reviewable enhancements, not unchecked truth.

nodes.name: V7.1 Overview - AI Boosted Apply Ready

parameters.content:
Default cost: $0

Default run uses:
- sample jobs
- deterministic scoring
- local resume drafting
- local truth validation
- local action queue

Optional boosters:
- Apify for fresh jobs only after live confirmation
- Gemini for cheap first AI review
- OpenAI only for top 1 to 2 resume finalists
- Perplexity only for top company/contact research
- Apps Script only for Google Doc/PDF and batch Sheet writes

No LinkedIn automation. Drafts and manual research tasks only.

AI booster rule:
Gemini = cheap job insight/scoring booster.
OpenAI = final resume and cover letter polish for top finalists only.
Perplexity = optional recruiter/company research for top networking targets only.

Before live use:

1. Create Google Sheet and use its real spreadsheet ID.
2. Set config.google_sheet_id to your actual ID or {{$env.AADIL_HR_SHEET_ID}}.
3. Deploy Google Apps Script endpoint for:
   - creating Google Docs
   - exporting PDFs
   - appending fixed-schema rows to tabs
4. Store Apps Script secret in n8n env var:
   AADIL_APPS_SCRIPT_SECRET
5. Fill Resume_Fact_Bank with verified metrics only.
6. Set human_review_approved_for_doc_generation = true only after reviewing resume drafts.

Required tabs:
Config
Resume_Fact_Bank
Raw_Jobs
Scored_Jobs
Tailored_Resumes
Contacts
Outreach
Cover_Letters
Action_Queue
Daily_Summary
Logs

V7 writes via a single apply_package to Apps Script so tabs are updated in a controlled sequence. This avoids parallel Sheets race conditions and avoids autoMapInputData fragility.

  "aadil_localhost_job_hunter";

  item.manual_job_text || ""
).trim();

  isLocalhostHunter &&
  incomingJobText
) {
  // The existing Manual Job Form node remains unchanged for normal manual runs.

Full-Time Internship

Full-Time

Job Description:
DP World is seeking a Human Resources - Systems Intern to support the HRIS team by improving HR systems, data integrity, reporting, and process efficiency. The intern will collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors while gaining hands-on experience with HR technology, analytics, dashboard development, and Human Capital Management systems.

Responsibilities:
HRIS Support
• Support HRIS team initiatives
• Improve HR system functionality
• Assist HRIS troubleshooting
• Maintain HR data integrity
• Support HR technology projects

Data Analytics
• Perform HR data cleanup
• Standardize employee data across HCM systems
• Analyze HR data trends
• Improve reporting accuracy
• Identify data inconsistencies

Dashboard Development
• Assist in building Regional HR Dashboard
• Consolidate data from multiple systems
• Generate HR reports
• Create actionable HR insights
• Support leadership reporting

Process Improvement
• Identify workflow inefficiencies
• Recommend process improvements
• Support implementation of enhancements
• Improve HR operational efficiency
• Optimize HRIS workflows

Support Management
• Create and manage IT support tickets
• Track vendor support requests
• Monitor issue resolution
• Maintain documentation
• Improve HRIS support processes

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with HR teams
• Work with Finance
• Collaborate with IT
• Coordinate with external vendors
• Gather business requirements

System Analysis
• Troubleshoot HR systems
• Identify root causes of issues
• Analyze system performance
• Recommend corrective actions
• Improve system reliability

Qualifications:
• Rising Senior or Master's student
• Human Resources, HRIS, Business, Information Systems or related major
• Academic exposure to HCM systems required
• HR process knowledge preferred
• Strong analytical skills
• Strong problem-solving ability
• Excellent communication skills
• Strong attention to detail
• Microsoft Excel proficiency
• Reporting/dashboard experience preferred
